pages.text: $(l)Vethea Garnet Farming$()$(li)Use 8 garnet miners instead of 1; each cycle takes 40s with 50% chance, so scaling linearly reduces wait time.$(li)Vethea garnets are obtainable before the Infinity Furnace;

mortum souls needed for the Infinity Furnace can be obtained from the Nightmare Callstone.$(li)All non-shyre garnets (including vethea, mortum, etc.) can be crafted via ME Mythic Assembler before the Infinity Furnace.
$(l)Sacred Acorn Acquisition$()$(li)Obtain sacred acorn tree logs via Void Botanical Resource Miner or by using a Beebee Gun on logs with leaves attached.
$(l)Pink Slime Farming$()$(li)Farm pink slime via Woot or ultimate mob farms.

$(l)Avoid Inefficiencies$()$(li)Skip the first Mortum Star recipe and craft the upgraded version directly; the first recipe is unnecessary and inefficient.$(li)Avoid recipes that use Ichorium when Ichorium Condensate is available; the latter is more efficient.

$(li)Ethaxium for Hihi/Parafrosynium is best obtained from the recipe (not drops).$(li)Carminite is easily farmed via DML or wood borers.$(li)For mob farming, Ultimate mob farms work but perform worse than Woot.
$(li)Do not rely on mob drops for Ethaxium—it’s inefficient and unreliable.
